Hold with 120+ Wrathful Fires: Fire DMG around him and enters Visage of Wrath.
Out of combat, hold: trades HP (never below 50%) for Wrathful Fires; at 120 he enters Visage of Wrath. One use on entering the field (once per 180s in Investigation Zones).
In Visage of Wrath, hold to spend 120 Wrathful Fires: throws a mountain for massive Fire DMG and leaves the state.
In Visage of Wrath after two different EX Specials: binds enemies with his beads for massive Fire DMG, then auto-follows with Toppling Mountain.
Press while attacking without moving: a guard stance that parries for Daze. Perfectly timed, it's a Perfect Block.
Half-circle + dodge: backstep and taunt. After an EX Special, input a command during it to chain into that EX Special.
Fires beads for Fire DMG; follows into either Basic chain's 2nd hit.
Fire attack after a Perfect Dodge; follows into either Basic chain's 3rd hit.

Dashing Fire attack after a Defensive Assist.
Dashing Fire attack after an Immovable Mountain parry.

Spend Adrenaline for one of four Fire moves: Earth Shaker (ground slams), Mountain Tremor (throws a mountain), One's Path (bead throw) and Lion's Roar (sonic wave). Each comes off a set point in his Basic chains, after an Assist Follow-Up, Dodge Counter or Quick Assist, or by command input during another EX, Immolate, Chain or Ultimate.
Command input during Earth Shaker gives Mountain Tremor - Wrath (bigger mountain); during One's Path gives Lion's Roar - Wrath (stronger wave).
Command-inputting an EX during another cancels it. Inside its Perfect Interrupt window it's a Perfect Cancel, easier in Visage of Wrath with Mountain's Might.

core.name: One With the Mountains
core.text:
Gains 0.1 Sheer Force per point of Max HP; all his Fire DMG is Sheer DMG, ignoring DEF. Enters battle with 60 Adrenaline (once per 180s in Investigation Zones).
Wrathful Fires (max 150): 0.5 per Adrenaline spent, 4 per Defensive Assist, 4 per Immovable Mountain parry (6 on Perfect Block) and 4 per Perfect Dodge (each once per 1s). None gained during Visage of Wrath.
Visage of Wrath grants 4 Mountain's Might: each EX then costs 1 Might instead of Adrenaline and refunds 10 Adrenaline. With Might, holding runs all four EXs and Toppling Mountain in a set order.
EX Special or Assist Follow-Up: Sheer Force +{0}, Fire DMG +{1}% and CRIT DMG +{2}% for 30s.

ability.name: Mountain's Zenith
ability.text: In Visage of Wrath, each EX that spends Mountain's Might (via Basic branch or command input) gives 1 Vidyaraja: +5% Fire DMG, max 3, 8s.

mindscapes: One's Path and Earth Shaker inflict Tremor (−10% Fire RES, 30s). His other EXs, Toppling Mountain and Crushing Peaks deal +10% Sheer DMG to Tremor targets. Crushing Peaks extends a Stun by 2s (once per Stun).
Core Passive CRIT DMG and Fire DMG +15% more each. Might-powered EXs refund 5 more Adrenaline.
Both Wrath EXs, Toppling Mountain and Crushing Peaks deal +30% DMG.
Every EX gives Vidyaraja, at any time; it gives +8% more Fire DMG and lasts 30s. Crushing Peaks adds 600% of Sheer Force as Fire DMG nearby. Battle Cry straight after an EX also gives Vidyaraja.
